title: Product noise operator
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set with probability mass function $\pi$, let $\rho\in[0,1]$, and let $f\colon\Omega^n\to\mathbb{R}$. The product noise operator sends $f$ to the function whose value at $x\in\Omega^n$ is the expectation of $f$ under the product noise kernel started at $x$.
